experimental_design: proteomic and phosphoproteomic characterizations of nine mouse tissues
To better understand the role of phosphorylation in maintenance of physiological differences among tissues, we performed proteomic and phosphoproteomic characterizations of nine mouse tissues.
factor_value: brain, brown fat, heart, liver, lung, kidney, pancreas, spleen, and testis
9 organs were harvested from three-week-old male Swiss-Webster mice: brain, brown fat, heart, liver, lung, kidney, pancreas, spleen, and testis.
number_of_samples: 9 organs were harvested from three-week-old male Swiss-Webster mice: brain, brown fat, heart, liver, lung, kidney, pancreas, spleen, and testis.
number_of_technical_replicates: Phosphopeptides were analyzed in duplicate via LC-MS/MS on an LTQ-Orbitrap mass spectrometer.
